results.question: what are our minions called?
results.reply:
Your subordinates are organized into the following ranks:

*   Inspector (metsuke; "one who directs their eye"): The officer assigned to each domain.
*   Escort (gosonin; "transport guard"): Members of an Inspector's team.

You can find the full chain of command in the [Wasp hierarchy](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/wasp-hierarchy).

results.question: Who is our boss?
results.reply: Our boss is [Tsuruchi Kyoma](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi-kyoma), the Distinguished Plenipotentiary to the Southern Allies of the Wasp.

results.question: who are the fortunes that the crab worship?
results.reply:
The Crab Clan's two patron Fortunes are:
- Bishamon (Fortune of strength)
- Ebisu (Fortune of honest work)

results.question: what are the imperial bounties?
results.reply: The current open Imperial bounties are listed in the [Imperial bulletin](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/imperial-bulletin).

results.question: what is the WASP org chart?
results.reply:
The Wasp hierarchy (chain of command) is:
* [Tsuruchi Kyoma](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi-kyoma) (Distinguished Plenipotentiary to the Southern Allies)
* Wasp Marshals (haribugyo; the PCs)
* Wasp Inspectors (metsuke; one per domain)
* Wasp Escorts (gosonin; Inspector's team members)

You can view the full [Wasp hierarchy](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/wasp-hierarchy) for more details.

results.question: what's the word for the guys who haul fugitives back for the reward?
results.reply: The term for the Wasp officers who help collect bounties and deliver fugitives is Escort, or *gosonin* ("transport guard").

results.question: what's our title in Japanese?
results.reply: Our title is *haribugyo*, which means "magistrates of the sting."

results.question: gosonin literally means what?

results.question: what do people call the wasp chancellery?
results.reply: The Wasp Clan chancellery is called "the Crane wives."

results.question: what's the name of the lineage for the wasp who used to be peasants?
results.reply: The Ami lineage (peasantborn lineage) is the Wasp's lineage for those raised from the peasant caste to the samurai caste.

results.question: what are the sparrow samurai who live in the villages called?
results.reply: Sparrow samurai who live in villages to manage them are called village overseers (mura-kantoku).

results.question: what's Kyoma's official title again

results.question: who reports to who in the wasp?
results.reply:
The Wasp hierarchy (chain of command) is:

results.question: what's the wasp founder's saying, the single arrow thing?
results.reply: "A single arrow, a single life" is the motto of [Tsuruchi](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi), the founder of the Wasp Clan, who preferred to strike down fugitives with his bow rather than challenge them to duels.

results.question: what was the name of the sword tsuruchi broke?

results.question: what does yoriki mean

results.question: who is the imperial chancellor

results.question: who's the superstitious lady who gave us the anti-fox charms?

results.question: what's Kyoma's wife's name

results.question: who's coming after us for the teahouse thing?
results.reply:
The Ikoma family is pursuing a blood feud against us for the death of [Ikoma Tsai](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-tsai) at the teahouse. The individuals coming for us are:

* [Ikoma Wataemon](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-wataemon) (Provincial Minister of Rites)
* [Ikoma Naohira](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-naohira) (Deputy Provincial Minister of War)

[The Family Reckoning](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/the-family-reckoning)

results.question: what does the ministry of retainers do?
results.reply: The Ministry of Retainers (a branch of the Six Ministries) is responsible for samurai stipends, ranks, civil service exams, and promotions. At the Imperial level, this ministry also awards honors and commendations.

results.question: which ministry pays samurai their stipends?
results.reply: The Ministry of Retainers (gosonin-sho) is responsible for samurai stipends, as well as ranks, civil service exams, and promotions.

results.question: what is the emerald champion?
results.reply: The Emerald Champion is the Imperial Minister of Justice, chosen by a dueling tournament to be the best duelist in the Empire and to duel on the Emperor's behalf.

results.question: what is the shogun?
results.reply: The Shogun is the title of the Imperial Minister of War, who oversees the Imperial legions.

results.question: what rank are we?
results.reply: As Wasp Marshals (haribugyo), you are of the upper 7th rank.

results.question: what rank is a county magistrate?
results.reply: A county magistrate is of the 5th rank.

results.question: what is the doctrine of three steps
results.reply: The Doctrine of Three Steps (also called the Measure of Standing) is the set of rules governing appropriate conduct and interaction between samurai of different ranks. It dictates the protocols for duels, arrests, and the handling of Imperial bounties, including how merits like advantages can shift one's perceived rank. You can find the full explanation of these rules in the [Doctrine of Three Steps](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/doctrine-of-three-steps).

results.question: how far does a blood feud reach?
results.reply: A blood feud (ketsuen) extends to every descendant of each named person's paternal great-grandfather on both sides. Any person within this range may lawfully kill any on the other side.

results.question: what was the family reckoning?
results.reply:
The Family Reckoning was a messy all-hands Wasp job involving the delivery of an Imperial summons to [Ikoma Yuan](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-yuan) at a teahouse.
The event resulted in the death of the Lion shugenja [Ikoma Tsai](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-tsai).
His relatives, [Ikoma Wataemon](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-wataemon), [Ikoma Naohira](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-naohira), and [Ikoma Ietsugu](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-ietsugu), declared a blood feud against the Wasp present.
This event is the source of the Righteous Sting and Venomous Sting custom advantages and disadvantages.
[The Family Reckoning](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/the-family-reckoning)

results.question: what does righteous sting mean?
results.reply:
Righteous Sting is a custom advantage in our campaign related to The Family Reckoning.
It means your relative at the teahouse acted honorably during that event.
It grants you a higher effective Rank and increases the party's Rank as well.

results.question: what does the peasantborn disadvantage do
results.reply: The Peasantborn disadvantage means you are the child of a peasant whom [Tsuruchi](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi) raised to the samurai caste. Because of this, you are never considered to be of peer standing with samurai-born individuals.

results.question: how much of a bounty do we keep?
results.reply: Traditionally, the collector keeps half of the bounty, their superior takes a tenth, and the remainder goes to the daimyo's treasury.
